The '''Colonial Station Chaf system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located within the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Space]] area of the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. It was connected by a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] to the [[Rhigar system/Legends|Rhigar system]] and to regions lying south of the core territory of the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] Ascendancy, the government of the Chiss [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="TEA" /> The system shared its name with the [[Chaf family/Legends|Chaf family]], one of the Chiss [[Ruling Families/Legends|Ruling Families]].<ref name="Survivor">''[[Survivor's Quest]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Colonial Station Chaf system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed it in grid square F-9.<ref name="TEA" />
